gaps: Archive: only 21 NEW cross-sourced exact-date events approved (plus 11 existing = 32 eligible); the >=60 target was not reachable with two independent publishers. Independent date sources found: RSSSF yearly pages (finals only), FBref daily match pages (1997 only), Wikipedia season pages. Most HPT Museum dates have no second publisher.

5 further dated events are staged as review: 12 Aug 1997 (single date source), Feyenoord legs 16/30 Sep 1992 (second-source date not legible), Toto Cup finals 22 Apr 1986 (Wikipedia disagrees: 21 Jan 1986), 23 Jan 1990 and 15 Apr 1991 (museum only), Grant appointment 1 Jul 1986 (Wikipedia only).

Players: 12 approved (cross-checked position+years), 24 review (single publisher or position conflict). Existing core.json squad identities with empty positions were not touched. Position conflicts: Stelmach (museum MF vs Wikipedia FW), Abarbanel (MF vs DF), Manor Hassan (FW vs MF), Luzon (GK vs MF).
Mysteries: 12 approved + 8 review = 20; the >=30 target needs a second publisher for more historic players (he.wikipedia / hamichlol / Transfermarkt were not fetchable).

Conflicting records not resolved: scorers of the 1992 State Cup final (RSSSF: Yosi Levi, Alon Hazan x2; museum: Eli Mahpud, Meni Basson x2) and the venue; museum 1993 relegation play-off scores vs RSSSF (3-0 and 2-1); Visoker caps (70 vs 40); museum claim of third place at a 1958 Asian Cup for the national team was not repeated (no such tournament edition found) .
Kits: no maker/sponsor source reached (museum article=35 uniforms page not fetched); kits section omitted.

Existing open conflicts from research-gaps.json (history-year-conflict, role-noam-cohen, squad-name-variants, hpt-match-3066, recent-detail-conflicts) were respected: none of those items are touched or resolved here.
Museum score notation is opponent:Hapoel (RTL); every score here is taken from RSSSF/Wikipedia/FBref order or the museum only after reconciling with those.
